sources.summary: Casa Atelier Brasilia explores the relationship between architecture, climate and domestic life through a precise recalibration of an existing home. The project begins with a simple ambition: to transform a conventional apartment into a sequence of quiet, connected spaces in which light, material and proportion shape everyday experience.
